method: Seasonal Mann-Kendall (whole year) and Hamed-Rao corrected Mann-Kendall (seasons, months); Sen's slope; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across districts per variable and period

FIRE.note: Whole-year trend uses yearly totals (counts are mostly zero month to month). Counts fires seen at the MODIS overpasses (~10:30 and ~13:30 local). Recent falls in Punjab may partly reflect burning shifted to later in the day, not only less burning.
